clients.title: Founder
clients._prospect_objection: I already have good referral relationships" — most PT owners rely on 2-3 physicians who refer inconsistently. The question isn't whether your current relationships are good, it's whether your pipeline is deep enough that losing one referral source wouldn't hurt.
clients._target_titles: Owner, Principal, Founder, Registered Investment Advisor, Wealth Manager, Managing Director
clients._value_prop: PT clinic growth runs on physician referrals — but building those relationships means cold outreach, follow-ups, and relationship management that takes time away from what you actually do best: treating patients. You didn't go to school for sales. ArgusReach handles all of it. We identify the right PCPs, orthopedic surgeons, and sports medicine doctors in your area, reach out in your name with personalized emails, and get meetings on your calendar with physicians who are open to referring. You stay focused on patients and clinical excellence. We keep your pipeline full.
clients._differentiator: Most outreach tools hand you a platform and wish you luck. We run the entire operation. We build the list, write the emails in your voice, manage every reply, and only bring you into the conversation when someone is actually interested. Every email is personalized to the specific practice we're reaching out to — our system reads their website and writes a custom opening line before anything sends. You never touch a cold lead.
clients._outcomes: New physician referral relationships. 2-5 meetings per month with PCPs and specialists in your area who are open to a referral conversation. A referral pipeline that keeps growing even when you're busy with patients.
clients._business_description: ArgusReach is a done-for-you outbound prospecting service for professional practices. PT clinic owners are busy — treating patients, managing staff, dealing with insurance, staying current on techniques. Business development shouldn't be one more thing on their plate. We handle everything: sourcing verified contacts, writing personalized outreach in your voice, managing every reply, and routing interested prospects straight to your calendar. Our clients show up to qualified meetings. We handle everything before the conversation.

sequence.body:
{{custom_intro}}

The busier you get serving existing clients, the harder it is to add new ones - not because of capability, but because there are only so many hours in the day.

We handle the front end entirely. We source qualified business owners in {{city}}, reach out in your name with personalized emails, and only bring you in when someone is actually interested in talking.

Worth 15 minutes to see if it fits?

sequence.subject: re: growing {{companyName}}
sequence.body:
Following up on my note, {{firstName}}.

I spent years on the private wealth management side in NYC and the institutional side here in Florida - portfolio management, investment strategy. I've watched great advisors hit a ceiling not from lack of skill but because business development never makes it to the top of the priority list when client work fills the calendar.

That's the problem we solve. No new hires, no cold calls, no cold emails on your end - just qualified meetings showing up on your calendar so you can do what you're already good at.

Happy to show you exactly how it works for a firm like {{companyName}}.

Vito Resciniti
Founder, ArgusReach
https://calendly.com/vito-argusreach/30min
